$comment: Authority for the DOE band validation rules B1-B8. docs/spec/DOE_BAND_MODEL.md is the prose;
this file is the executable form, and both sides (client2/src/doe_bands.js today, a server
validator when the model lands) must answer identically.
THE RULE THIS FILE EXISTS TO PIN: every rule is evaluated PER VALUE, never per row.
`A 2-15` beside `B,C 2-15` is not an overlap. A fixture where every band scopes to a single
value cannot tell a per-value implementation from a per-row one, so several cases below
deliberately mix ALL / single / multi scopes in one plan.
`expect_blocks` and `expect_warns` are SETS of rule ids (order-independent, duplicates
collapsed). Messages are not asserted - they are Korean user-facing text and will be
reworded; what must not drift is WHICH rule fires.

expansion_cases.name: ALL_expands_to_every_defined_value
expansion_cases.$why: A plan built entirely from ALL rows must still validate per value like any other.

expansion_cases.name: comma_string_scope_is_accepted
expansion_cases.$why: The sketch writes `B,C` in one cell; the panel may hand it over unsplit.

expansion_cases.name: undefined_names_are_returned_not_dropped
expansion_cases.$why: B4 has to be able to name them. Dropping here would make the reference vanish silently.

$comment: `bandLayerSpan` returns null for 'cannot be computed' and an ARRAY for a real range.
No current caller can tell null from [] - both produce zero coverage and zero demand -
so without these assertions the distinction is an equivalent mutant and would rot.
It is pinned anyway because this codebase's standing rule is that '확인 못 함' must never
collapse into '0' (PRIMITIVES section 7): the next caller to ask `span.length === 0`
would silently read an unreadable boundary as an empty range.

plan_cases.name: users_own_sketch_minus_the_typo_is_valid
plan_cases.$why: ALL 1-1 / A 2-15 / B,C 2-15 / ALL 16-16. Two rows share 2-15 for different dies.

plan_cases.name: users_own_sketch_AS_DRAWN_is_an_overlap
plan_cases.$why: Row 4 was typed `ALL 15-16`. Layer 15 is already covered for A, B and C. The user called it a mistake and asked for it to be caught.

plan_cases.name: same_range_different_values_is_NOT_an_overlap
plan_cases.$why: The per-value rule in its purest form. A per-row implementation blocks this correct plan.

plan_cases.name: overlap_inside_one_value_of_a_multi_value_band
plan_cases.$why: The other direction: B is covered twice, A once. A per-row check sees two disjoint scopes and passes.

plan_cases.name: gap_in_the_middle_of_one_value
plan_cases.$why: Someone nudged 2-15 to 2-12 and forgot. 13-15 vanished for A only.

plan_cases.name: gap_at_layer_1_ONLY
plan_cases.$why: Pins the lower bound of the sweep. With from=3 above, layers 1 AND 2 are missing, so a sweep that wrongly starts at 2 still finds layer 2 and fires anyway. Only a stack starting at exactly 2 can tell the two implementations apart.

plan_cases.name: value_defined_but_covered_by_nothing
plan_cases.$why: B8. Distinct from B6: there is no max to measure a gap against.

plan_cases.name: from_below_one
plan_cases.$why: Reported as B2, not as a gap. FROM 0 with TO 5 would otherwise read as a confusing coverage result.

plan_cases.name: unreadable_from_is_B3_not_a_silent_zero
plan_cases.$why: '0x10' used to coerce to 16 on one side and 0 on the other. Both boundaries go through the SAME classifier as `to` always did.

plan_cases.name: blank_to_is_B3_too
plan_cases.$why: blank and invalid are ONE case for validation - both mean 'no number', and coverage cannot be computed from either.

plan_cases.name: duplicate_material_inside_one_band_is_a_WARN
plan_cases.$why: Save proceeds. It changes the per-material share, but the user may genuinely mean two reels of the same lot.

plan_cases.name: unassigned_TOP_range_is_blocked_by_B9
plan_cases.$why: B9. max(V) is the highest COVERED layer, so a top range nobody assigned simply lowers max and all eight other rules pass - a 16-layer stack silently becomes 15. Blocked as of 2026-07-27 (user: 빈 층 있으면 저장시키지 말고). Compare with the MIDDLE case below: identical mistake, caught by B6, which is exactly the position-dependent asymmetry B9 removes.

plan_cases.name: unassigned_MIDDLE_range_IS_caught_by_B6
plan_cases.$why: The contrast that proves the hole is specifically about the top. Same defect, different position, opposite outcome.

plan_cases.name: B10_whole_lot_and_its_own_slot_in_the_same_bin
plan_cases.$why: MID1:2 covers every slot at BIN 2; MID1_03:2 covers slot 03 at BIN 2. Slot 03 is counted twice, and inflated demand shows up as a shortage at the worst moment.

plan_cases.name: B10_does_NOT_fire_across_different_bins
plan_cases.$why: Different BIN = different pool = no double count. A rule that ignored BIN would block a legitimate plan.

plan_cases.name: B10_fires_within_a_single_band_too
plan_cases.$why: The overlap is a property of the plan, not of a row pair.

plan_cases.name: bare_lot_name_is_now_a_valid_material
plan_cases.$why: The reversal, exercised through the whole validator and not just the parser.

plan_cases.name: several_rules_at_once_are_all_reported
plan_cases.$why: The panel names every reason at once; a validator that returns the first failure makes the user fix one thing per save.

$comment: GRAMMAR (user-confirmed 2026-07-27):  token ::= identifier [ ':' BIN ] ;
identifier ::= lot '_' slot (one slot) | lot (WHOLE LOT, every slot) ; BIN omitted -> 1.
Both separators split from the RIGHT: a lot name may contain ':' and '_'.
THIS GROUP SUPERSEDES contracts/band_arithmetic material_split_cases, which pins
`splitMaterialId`. Exactly ONE legacy case changes meaning: `no_separator` ('ABC')
went from REFUSE to 'the whole lot ABC'. Every other refusal stands, because the
never-guess principle is unchanged - a bare lot name is now a DEFINED meaning, not
an unresolvable input. `splitMaterialId` is deleted when the model lands; until then
both contracts are green because both describe the function they actually pin.

material_token_cases.name: whole_lot_bin_defaults_to_1
material_token_cases.$why: THE REVERSAL. Under splitMaterialId this refused.

material_token_cases.name: colon_inside_lot_name_survives
material_token_cases.$why: Splitting from the right is what leaves room for this.

material_token_cases.name: empty_bin_refused
material_token_cases.$why: Never fall back to 1 - a typed colon says the user meant to pick a bin.

material_token_cases.name: hex_bin_refused
material_token_cases.$why: '0x10' became 16 on one side and 0 on the other once already. Same integer reader as the layer boundaries.

material_token_cases.name: trailing_underscore_still_refused
material_token_cases.$why: A dangling separator is a typo, not a scope. Reading it as 'whole lot' would be the guess this grammar still refuses.

material_token_cases.name: pool_key_lot_scope_differs_from_slot_scope
material_token_cases.$why: The whole lot and one of its slots are DIFFERENT pools and must never collide in the rollup key.

material_token_cases.name: pool_key_ambiguous_boundary_does_not_collide
material_token_cases.$why: REGRESSION 2026-07-27. A key built by concatenating lot+slot+bin with no separator makes MID1_12:3 and MID11_2:3 the same string, so two unrelated pools merge into one rollup row and their 사용 is summed. It happened: the U+001F separators in the first version were silently dropped on write. Any keying scheme must survive this pair.

material_token_cases.name: pool_key_lot_scope_is_not_a_stringified_null
material_token_cases.$why: If the key were built as `${lot}|${slot}|${bin}` with slot=null for whole-lot scope, a slot literally named null would collide with the whole lot. Identity must come from the SCOPE, not from how null prints.

material_token_cases.name: pool_key_bin_is_part_of_identity
material_token_cases.$why: Collapse BIN and 잔여 comes out low with no visible cause.

rollup_cases.name: same_map_different_bins_do_not_compete
rollup_cases.$why: The reason BIN is a dimension at all: two values drawing different BINs from one DT map are separate pools.

rollup_cases.name: bundle_is_split_evenly_with_the_ceiling_taken_once_per_material
rollup_cases.$why: Shares of one band sum to MORE than its total. Deliberate: rounding down hides a shortfall.

rollup_cases.name: whole_lot_is_its_own_pool_alongside_a_slot_of_the_same_lot
rollup_cases.$why: B10 blocks this combination for the SAME bin; the rollup must still keep them apart when the bins differ.

$comment: 잔여 = 가용 − 사용, but ONLY when 가용 is trustworthy. A confident figure derived from
an untrustworthy input is worse than none: 0 reads as 'all consumed'.

remaining_cases.name: reliable_and_short
remaining_cases.$why: A negative 잔여 is a real, showable answer - it is the shortage the plan must surface.

remaining_cases.name: bin_absent_is_NOT_zero
remaining_cases.$why: THE RED RULE. Default BIN 1 missing from that map must be reported, never rendered as 가용 0 - zero reads as consumed, the truth is 'that bin does not exist here'.

remaining_cases.name: reasons_are_distinguishable
remaining_cases.$why: THE POINT OF THE RED RULE. All three hide the number, but the user must be able to tell bin-absent from server-flaky from not-yet-asked. Wording is not pinned (Korean, will be reworded); DISTINCTNESS is.

$comment: In the old model `bands` lived INSIDE the value's row, so a rename carried them along
for free. With the inversion the reference is BY NAME and a rename orphans it. Call at
the same site that already remaps grid cells (updateLegendRowForPanel -> remapGridValues).

rename_cases.name: rename_onto_a_sibling_merges_rather_than_duplicating
rename_cases.$why: Otherwise the band would list the same value twice and its layer would read as double-covered under B5.

rename_cases.name: ALL_scope_is_untouched_by_a_rename
rename_cases.$why: ALL is resolved at expansion time, so it never holds a stale name.

demand_cases.name: ceiling_does_not_distribute_over_a_multi_value_band
demand_cases.$why: THE arithmetic trap of the inversion. Per-value shares summed give 4; one ceiling over the summed total gives 3. Storing or displaying the wrong one is the ceil/round family of defect.

demand_cases.name: layers_come_from_typed_boundaries_not_from_a_walk
demand_cases.$why: 2-15 is 14 layers wherever the row sits in the array. No prevTo, no position.

demand_cases.name: no_material_means_no_share_but_the_total_still_stands
demand_cases.$why: The demand exists; nothing is assigned to carry it. B7 blocks the save, but the number shown must not pretend the demand is zero.
